create_mt5_config: create an MT5Config instance with custom model hyperparameters for mT5 transformer
init_mt5_config_default: initialize MT5Config with default mT5-small architecture settings
validate_mt5_architecture: validate the MT5Config feed_forward_proj setting against supported activation formats
customize_mt5_hyperparameters: customize mT5 model hyperparameters like d_model, num_layers, and num_heads in MT5Config
configure_mt5_embeddings: configure MT5Config with tied word embeddings and encoder-decoder architecture settings
